subject: Sustainment bounty proposal to preserve pilot access
messages:
From: Lucas Park <lucas.park@orchidhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot pause — PO with legal in escrow, options?

Hi Camila,

Quick heads up — our procurement team just moved the PO into a legal review bucket this morning after a vendor questionnaire flag. Finance says the money is approved but legal wants a couple of addenda, so the formal PO could be in escrow for 5–7 business days.

We're mid-run on the pilot and the data team is already starting to see value; if the environment is paused they'll lose momentum and the exec sponsor will get cold. Is there anything Redwood can do in the short term to keep the sandbox available while our legal team finishes the review?

I can get an expedited sign-off from procurement if there are simple guardrails we need to accept. Appreciate any short-term options you can propose.

Thanks,
Lucas
Director of Data & Analytics
Orchid Health
l.park@orchidhealth.com

--
Attachment: procurement_questionnaire_final.pdf (stub)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Park <lucas.park@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot pause — PO with legal in escrow, options?

Hi Lucas — thanks for the heads up and for outlining the timeline. Really glad to hear the team is seeing traction.

Short summary of what I can offer immediately (proposal):
- Sustainment bounty: temporary credit pool to keep the pilot environment live for up to 5 business days while your PO clears legal.
- Size: nominally 200,000 tokens (approx. equivalent to ~3,000 API calls for your current workload) with usage alerts at 50% and 80%.
- Conditions: non-production usage only, cannot be exported; Redwood will collect basic usage metrics for commercial evaluation.
- Acceptance: we need a one-line email from procurement acknowledging the timeline and that the PO is in active legal review.

If that sounds workable I can route this for fast-track approval from Sales Ops and Finance; hoping we can get a yes within a few hours. I've attached draft terms for a brief sustainment grant so legal has minimal language to review.

Subject: Re: Pilot pause — PO with legal in escrow, options?

Camila — thanks for the clear proposal.

Approved: we can offer Orchid Health a 5-business-day sustainment grant of 200,000 tokens under the draft terms attached. Please proceed with the following steps:
1) Ask procurement to send a one-line confirmation that the PO is in active legal review and expected to clear within 7 business days.
2) Send the sustainment grant terms to procurement and request an email acknowledgement.
3) Limit the grant to non-production endpoints and activate usage alerts for both the customer and our team.

I am copying David to confirm billing treatment (temporary credit applied to pilot account) and Sales Ops for tracking. I also added a HubSpot note and linked the deal (ORCH-7821).

Camila — once you have procurement's confirmation, I'll execute the grant from my side. If legal requests any additional language beyond the draft terms, loop in Legal and cc me so I can escalate.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
